run_quac_teacher: run the DefaultTeacher to load and serve QuAC dataset examples in ParlAI dialog format
build_quac_data: build and download the QuAC dataset converting train and validation JSON to ParlAI text format
get_quac_data_path: get the file path for a QuAC dataset split by datatype using the _path function
convert_quac_to_parlai: convert raw QuAC JSON paragraphs with question-answer pairs into ParlAI dialog format using make_parlai_format
review_quac_defaultteacher: review the DefaultTeacher class that extends ParlAIDialogTeacher to serve QuAC reading comprehension data
